recall.title: Fisher-Price Recalls Infant Cradle Swings Due to Fall Hazard
recall.hazard: When the seat peg is not fully engaged the seat can fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury to the child.
recall.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled cradle swing and contact Fisher-Price for revised assembly instructions.
recall.tell: Check the product number located on the seat under the pad for models CHM84, CMR40, or CMR43.

demo-swing.verdict: Same brand and kind as the Cradle 'n Swings, recalled April 2016. The listing doesn't show which model.
demo-swing.question: Hi, before I buy: could you send a photo of the label showing the model number and manufacture date? I'd like to check it against a CPSC recall (16143, Cradle 'n Swings).
